# backend/tests/fixtures/mcp_apps_phase0

## Purpose

Task-owned, provider-free MCP Apps Phase 0 fixtures. They expose only deterministic test state over explicitly started stdio, Streamable HTTP, and legacy SSE transports. Production code never imports or selects this directory.

## Files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `phase0_standard_apps_fixture.py` | Canonical task entrypoint that launches the colocated Node implementation from the active toolchain. |
| `phase0_standard_apps_fixture.mjs` | Named `phase0-standard-apps-fixture` plus distinct IM Node proxy, permission metadata vectors, standard Apps tool/resource, and Node-locality probes. |

## Rollback

Delete this directory as part of `phase0-isolated-poc-cleanup`; no database or production runtime cleanup is involved.
